SELECT tea_order_seq.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
insert into tea_order(o_no, o_date, o_deliver, o_price, o_earn, o_passwd, o_name, o_phone, o_zip, o_addr, o_email, o_message, o_pay, m_no, paymentId, o_used_cash) values(#{o_no}, SYSDATE, '기본배송', #{o_price, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{o_earn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{o_passwd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{o_name, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{o_phone, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{o_zip, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{o_addr, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{o_email, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{o_message, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{o_pay, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{m_no, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{paymentId}, #{o_used_cash})

insert into tea_order_detail(od_no, od_qty, od_product, od_price, o_no, p_no) values(tea_order_detail_seq.NEXTVAL, #{od_qty, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{od_product, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{od_price, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{o_no, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{p_no, jdbcType=INTEGER})
mapper.select: select o.*, nvl(m.m_id, '비회원') as m_id, nvl(m.m_name, o.o_name) as m_name from tea_order o left join tea_member m on o.m_no = m.m_no where o_no = #{o_no}
select od.*, p.p_name, p.p_price, p.p_img from tea_order_detail od join tea_product p on od.p_no = p.p_no where od.o_no = #{o_no}
select o.o_no, o.o_price, o.o_pay, o.o_name, o.o_date, nvl(m.m_id, '비회원') as m_id, nvl(m.m_name, o.o_name) as m_name from tea_order o left join tea_member m on o.m_no = m.m_no order by o.o_date desc

select o.o_no, o.o_price, o.o_pay, o.o_name, o.o_date, od.od_qty, od.od_product, od.od_price, p.p_img, p.p_name from tea_order o join tea_order_detail od on o.o_no = od.o_no left join tea_product p on od.p_no = p.p_no where o.m_no = #{m_no} order by o.o_date desc
